title: 4 tests exist but none actually run — repair goal unmet
evidence: .coverage (coverage 7.15.2) shows tests/test_api.py only executed def/decorator lines [1,2,3,5,6,12,13,27,28,46,47] — the test BODIES (7-10,14-25,29-44,48-64) never ran; app/main.py endpoint bodies (61-70,74-82,86-93,97-109,113-121,126) show 0 coverage, so no endpoint was ever hit. Cause: tests are @pytest.mark.asyncio async coroutines but the workspace has NO async support (grep found no pytest-asyncio/anyio/asyncio_mode, no requirements.txt) and uses httpx's removed AsyncClient(app=...) shortcut. test_coverage=0.33 (scores.json) is import-only line coverage, not a pass rate. FEEDBACK.md required the repair to make tests pass; they still do not.
suggestion: Add pytest-asyncio (+ asyncio_mode=auto config) and switch to AsyncClient(transport=ASGITransport(app=app)); or rewrite as sync tests using fastapi.testclient.TestClient.

title: Validation rejects missing title/author with 422, spec asked for 400
evidence: app/main.py:43-50 BookCreate marks title/author required, so FastAPI/pydantic rejects with HTTP 422 (the test at tests/test_api.py:51 asserts 422). REQUIREMENTS.json R9 how_to_verify specifies rejection with 400.
suggestion: Acceptable as a 4xx rejection; add a validation exception handler returning 400 if strict spec conformance is required.

title: DELETE returns 204 with a JSON body
evidence: app/main.py:121 returns JSONResponse(status_code=204, content={}); HTTP 204 responses must not carry a body.

title: Deprecated pydantic v1 idioms (orm_mode, Field example=)
evidence: app/main.py:56 uses class Config: orm_mode = True and lines 44-47 use Field(..., example=...); both are pydantic v1 style, deprecated under pydantic v2.
suggestion: Use model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True) and json_schema_extra for examples.
